note: Every upstream NFR mapped to how U4 satisfies it or why it does not apply. N/A rows name the owning Unit rather than saying 'not applicable', so a reader can follow the obligation. The OK rows for NFR9 and NFR14 carry the most weight: U4 has the first real money column, which turns B3's schema assertion from a statement of intent into a check, and it is the first Unit with two teachers for data to leak between.

coverage.target: Android target and compile SDK - U10 release-packaging. U4 ships Compose screens, not build configuration.
Device floor and AAB size - U10. U4's Room cache holds kilobytes of roster rows and does not move the number.
Languages - every new U4 string lands in both bundles, under the per-string test B3 established. The roster and child-selection screens are the first lists, where Bangla length pressure is greatest.
Offline reads - NFR4.1 and NFR4.2. Rosters cache in Room and render WITH their fetched_at; staleness is shown rather than hidden, because a stale read is V1's only offline state.
Offline writes - U5 owns the mid-class queue. V1 accepts no write without connectivity here [TC-8], so U4 has no queue to model.
Queue semantics - U5's four states. U4 has no queued write.
Scale ceiling - NFR6.11 through NFR6.14 and NFR10.5 through NFR10.9. The ceiling is what licenses no pagination and no replica, so it is restated rather than assumed.
Infrastructure cost - U4 adds no infrastructure. Recorded because the cost ceiling is what forbids the read replica NFR10's section C rejects.
Data residency - none required; unchanged by this Unit.
Money representation - BR3.2 and BR3.3. U4 has the FIRST real money column, so B3's schema assertion stops being vacuous. A.6 builds the TypeDecorator team.md specifies and B1 correctly never built.

Children's data at rest - satisfied by the storage tier, unchanged. NFR14 section D records why field-level encryption on display_name is NOT added: it would make the roster unsearchable for no additional protection.
Device identifiers - none introduced. B3's source-level scan already covers every Kotlin file U4 adds.
OTP abuse controls - U3's. U4 sends no SMS; BR6.3 forbids notifying a dormant enrollment at all.
Per-purpose SMS budget - U3's gateway. U4 has no send path.
Token lifetimes - U3's. U4 consumes the lens the token resolves to and issues nothing.

Privacy boundary - NFR14.12 through NFR14.21. THE UNIT'S CENTRE OF GRAVITY: first Bolt with two teachers to leak between, first writer of display_name, and the erasure markers whose per-link split was found by working the four states.

Accessibility and back-stack - the child switcher changes a path parameter [BR5.1], which is what makes a stale back-stack entry refusable by the server rather than silently serving the newly selected child.
API versioning - every U4 route is additive under /v1/. The column RENAME is internal and changes no wire field.
Backend coverage - U4's packages join the explicit --cov list, which B3's coverage-scope gate now asserts against the packages on disk in both directions.
